title: Hall photon theory, copyrighted 1997 and inspired by faster-than-light craft

tellings.quote: I first copyrighted whole photon theory in 1997

plain: Charles Hall, a man who says he spent three years among tall white aliens at an Air Force range in Nevada, says the craft he saw there going faster than light inspired a physics theory of his own about photons. Hall says he first copyrighted this theory in 1997. He lays it out in books he names, Beyond Relativity, Mirage Galaxies and Edges in Space, and Walking with the Tall Whites Aftermath.
